Which statement explains why isotopes of an element have the same chemical reactions?
A
They have different numbers of neutrons.
B
They have ions with different numbers of electrons.
C
They have the same number of outer shell electrons.
D
They have the same number of protons.

options.label: A
options.text: They have different numbers of neutrons.

options.label: B
options.text: They have ions with different numbers of electrons.

options.label: C
options.text: They have the same number of outer shell electrons.

options.label: D
options.text: They have the same number of protons.
